OutdoorTilesheet Fence Replacement.AllowValues: Nothing, Only Grass Recolor, Grass Recolor + Retexture
OutdoorTilesheet Fence Replacement.Description: 'Nothing': If you pick this, nothing will be added. 'Only Grass Recolor': If you pick this, recolored grass/snow will be added at the bottom. Can be used on top of other fence replacement mods. Pick 'Nothing' if it doesn't line up or you don't like it. 'Grass Recolor + Retexture': Replaces the fence with one matching the Craftable Seasonal Hardwood Fence that can be added with this mod.

TownTilesheet Fence Replacement.Description: 'Nothing': If you pick this, nothing will be added. 'Only Grass Recolor': If you pick this, recolored grass will be added at the bottom. Can be used on top of other fence replacement mods. Pick 'Nothing' if it doesn't line up or you don't like it.

Make Craftable Hardwood Fence Seasonal.Description: Makes the Craftable Hardwood Fence seasonal. Matches the option 'Grass Recolor + Retexture' under 'OutdoorTilesheet Fence Replacement'. Can be disabled if you want to use a different fence replacement mod, or you don't like it.

Cosmetic Map Patches.Description: Adds some small cosmetic fixes to the beach edges on the Main Beach, Ginger Island, and East Scarp, the snow/grass edges in East Scarp Remastered and some Festivals, that might look disconnected otherwise.

Fertilizer as cute weeds.Description: Can be used to turn the fertilizer into the cute vanilla weeds.

Force Grass/Snow on Bottom of Tilesheet.Description: Adjusted to the Vanilla Trees. Can be used on top of other tree/foliage replacement mods. Works with Simple Foliage. Disable if it doesn't line up or you don't like it.

Force Grass in Front of Town Buildings.Description: Adjusted to the Vanilla Buildings. Can be used on top of other building replacement mods. Disable if it doesn't line up or you don't like it.
